claims.text: Where a business produces no assessable profit, or an assessable profit less than expected from that business, or where the true amount of the assessable profit cannot be readily ascertained, the relevant tax authority may act under the deemed profit rule.

In the case of a resident, the relevant tax authority may assess and charge that taxable person on such fair and reasonable percentage of the gross income from the trade or business as the relevant tax authority may determine.
